description: The 5 records of one BandIt import run that best match a name or a description, across bandit-raw-pages and bandit-raw-orgs. Hybrid search: a keyword match on name and a semantic match on text, merged with reciprocal rank fusion. Use it to find which organization a prize tag, a person's company or a differently named sponsor refers to.

configuration.query: FROM bandit-raw-pages, bandit-raw-orgs METADATA _id, _index, _score | WHERE run_id == ?run_id | FORK (WHERE MATCH(name, ?query) | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT 10) (WHERE MATCH(text, ?query) | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT 10) | FUSE | SORT _score DESC | EVAL text = SUBSTRING(text, 1, 200) | KEEP source_key, record_kind, name, domain, org_key, text | LIMIT 5

run_id.description: The import run id given in the task.

query.description: A name, prize tag or short description to look up, for example "Annapurna Labs" or "Factory AI".
